My last stop was Hanauma Bay Nature Preserve, a vibrant coral reef located in a volcanic crater. I was able to snorkel the shallow waters and witness the abundant sea life up close. I also had the chance to try the traditional Hawaiian sport of paddleboarding. It was a great way to explore the bay and take in the surrounding beauty.
